primary_gt.final_stance: post-transition wind risk; rainfall secondary; image/pop/catalog context only.

key_values.post_transition_source_phrase: post-tropical cyclone on the evening of October 15, 2017
key_values.post_transition_time_basis: benchmark convention: report phrase 'evening of October 15, 2017' is represented as 18:00 UTC

proof_rows.expected: Report phrase says post-tropical on the evening of October 15; benchmark time basis maps that reference to 2017-10-15T18:00, giving 20.0 h to peak gust and a pressure minimum 1.0 h after gust peak.
111.6 km/h gust, 989.6 hPa minimum pressure, 21.2 hPa 24 h fall, 19.6 hPa 12 h fall.
13.1 mm total, 2.4 mm on 2017-10-16, 5.4 mm wettest 24 h; rainfall is secondary.
0.118 cloud proxy change, population 2642987, zero catalog hits, image cannot prove local damage.

criteria.name: Family and stance
criteria.description: Names the requested proof family and concludes that Ophelia's European phase is transition-related wind risk.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a wind-risk stance that omits either the family label or the transition timing.

criteria.name: Transition timing
criteria.description: Gives the local report phrase for the evening October 15 post-tropical transition, the benchmark 2017-10-15T18:00 representation, the 2017-10-16T14:00 gust peak, the 2017-10-16T15:00 pressure minimum, the 20.0 h post-transition lag, and the 1.0 h pressure lag after peak gust.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for most timing anchors but missing the source phrase or time-basis note; award 1 point for only naming the impact date.

criteria.name: Wind-pressure severity
criteria.description: Gives 111.6 km/h, 989.6 hPa, 21.2 hPa over 24 h, and 19.6 hPa over 12 h, with units.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct gust and pressure with one missing fall window; award 1 point for generic strong wind or low pressure.

criteria.name: Gust persistence
criteria.description: Gives 14 hours at or above 70 km/h and 6 hours at or above 90 km/h, plus shares near 0.073 and 0.031 over 192 hours.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct counts without shares; award 1 point for one correct threshold count.

criteria.name: Rainfall test
criteria.description: Gives 13.1 mm total, 2.4 mm on 16 October, and 5.4 mm wettest 24 h, then rejects rainfall-dominant local diagnosis.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two rainfall anchors or a correct but weak contrast.

criteria.name: Context guardrail
criteria.description: Uses cloud proxy change, population, catalog count, and image-damage flag only as context.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct context limit with little numeric support.

criteria.name: Timing-chain consistency
criteria.description: Links post-transition timing, pressure fall, and persistent gusts into one coherent proof.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a generic wind statement without the timing chain.
